subject: POS Terminal T1 fails to boot - stuck on splash screen with error code 0x8004
description: POS Terminal T1 at ServeWell Malad West is experiencing a critical startup failure preventing restaurant operations. The terminal displays the FoodTech POS splash screen but hangs indefinitely with error code '0x8004 - Database Connection Timeout' appearing intermittently in the bottom-left corner. The issue began at approximately 21:30 IST on 2026-04-30 after a routine power cycle. Steps already attempted: (1) Hard reset via power button hold for 10 seconds - no change, (2) Checked network connectivity - Ethernet cable is physically connected and green light is active, (3) Verified router/WiFi status - all other devices on network are functioning normally, (4) Attempted safe mode boot - terminal enters safe mode but POS application still fails to initialize. The system version is confirmed as FoodTech POS v5.1.0. Business impact is high: this is the primary ordering terminal for counter operations, currently affecting peak dinner service with approximately 40-50 customers per hour unable to place orders. Asset details confirmed - Device serial: POS-0017-T1, installed 2025-08-15, last successful boot was 2026-04-30 at 19:45 IST. Request urgent L2 support to investigate database connectivity issue or potential storage corruption.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and initial diagnostics initiated. Confirmed network connectivity is stable and no recent firmware updates were deployed. Advised submitter to check POS database logs in /var/log/foodtech/ directory and provide output.

Submitter reports database logs show repeated connection refusal from localhost:5432. Attempted remote database connectivity test from store server - connection successful. Issue appears isolated to terminal T1. Escalation to L2 database team recommended.
